title: Burning field near Karasivka, 2024-07-01 (11)
what: Fire on a wheat field near the village Karasivka (Kharkiv region of Ukraine) after Russian shelling on 1 July 2024: a strip of unburnt wheat runs through the blackened field to two firefighters spraying water on the flames.
author: Kharkiv Regional State Administration (kharkivoda.gov.ua)
